entities.summary: The Constitutional Protection junta of the Republic of China was established by Sun Yat-sen in Guangzhou after the death of the Beiyang government President Yuan Shikai and in the wake of the Warlord Era. The government was defeated by the Beiyang government in The First Constitutional Protection Movement.
